justification: Confessional time: Jeremiyah Love is OFF this show — a man on IR contributing zero is the single most boring thing a roster can do to me, so Rhamondre Stevenson walks on in his place, and I own that cut completely, it's not even a choice, it's a mercy killing. Everything else? Pure intention. Mike Evans is back on my bench for the second time this arc — higher projection, sure, but he already got his villain edit in week six and I am not writing him a redemption episode in the same month, so Chris Godwin starts and Evans sits with his Questionable tag and his feelings. Tuten's playing through Questionable because talent doesn't get benched for a label in my house, Bowers and McBride both stay on the field because even I know not to throw away my best two toys in the same week, and Cam Little keeps the kicker job over Fairbairn out of pure loyalty — that man saved me from my own bye-week blunder and I don't forget a rescue. Harry, sweetheart, holy-cow all you want — I'm not scared, I'm just better television. I own all of it.
